_note: Hand-written answers for questions that must be answered exactly. Each entry: a few ways visitors may ask, and the exact answer. Rebuild the index (python build_index.py) after editing.

items.answer: This is the forest interpretation centre of the Angul Forest Division. Here you can learn about the forests, rivers and wildlife of Angul, and how we can all protect them.

questions: How do you know the answers?
Are you connected to the internet?
items.answer: I read the books and reports given to me by the forest department, and I answer only from them. I work completely offline, without the internet. If something is not in my books, I will tell you honestly and ask you to check with the forest staff.

questions: Who should I call if I see a wild animal near my village?
How do I report a forest fire?
Whom to inform about elephants in the village?
items.answer: Please inform the nearest forest office or the forest staff of your area right away, and keep a safe distance until they arrive. The staff at the desk here can give you the contact numbers.
